identity_sources.notes: Exact standing institution, country and jurisdiction claims retained in the 24 October complete claim report and reconciled with the current own parliamentary identity and provider designation. No new API fetch asserted.

channel.provenance_note: The owned parliament homepage directly designates this exact channel. Selected 20 October 2026 Sports and Childhood committee-speaker recordings were confirmed in both engines. A fresh 19 October Budget committee sample advances in Chromium; WebKit briefly decodes its budget slide and then stalls. These are committee recordings, not an assertion of complete plenary/live coverage. The parliament represents the French Community across Wallonia and Brussels; its Brussels map marker is an institutional location, not a jurisdiction outline.

accessibility.notes: Selected visual samples do not establish audible quality, all spoken languages, caption accuracy, signing or audio description across the service.

permission.summary: The legislature designates a public institutional viewing service. No independent third-party audiovisual playback, embedding, recording, rebroadcast or reuse grant was established. Website ownership, publication/redaction rules and general information-licence pages are not treated as audiovisual permission. Programme-data republication is separately unresolved.
permission.recommendation: Open the official viewing source. Resolve each intended media or programme-data use separately before implementing it.
